# Mbale Progressive Secondary School

> Mbale Progressive Secondary School is a mixed day and boarding secondary school in Mbale City, Uganda. The school motto is “The Love of Education Brought Us Here.”

## School facts

- Established: 1993
- Population: more than 1,500 students across Day Campus and Mbale Progressive Annex
- Day Campus: Nyanza Road, near Namatala, Mbale City
- Boarding campus: Mbale Progressive Annex
- Office hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00–17:00; families should confirm holiday and visitation arrangements before travelling
- UCE/O-Level: more than 17 subject areas and more than 400 candidates each year
- UACE/A-Level: more than 15 subject areas and more than 300 candidates each year

## 2025 academic achievements

- Best NLSC UCE 2025 student: 9 As in 9 subjects and an A in Project Work
- Best UACE 2025 student: Worasi Joel, 18 points, 2ABB3 in BCM / ICT
- 2025 UCE results include subject grade distributions and A–C/A–D pass rates on the Academics page

## Student life and achievements

- Football: Mbale Progressive reached the Round of 16 at the 2026 National Boys Football Championship in Lira and was ranked 14th nationally.
- Debate: the Debate Society reached the NIRA national knockout rounds and finished First Runners-Up at the 93.1 IUIU FM Inter-School Debate Championship in 2025/2026.
- Table tennis: the school’s documented history includes the 2016 Kenya Thika Open and Kateregga Memorial Schools Championship.
- Clubs and faith associations include Red Cross, Writers’ Club, Science Club, Interact Club, Muslim Students Association, Young Catholics Association, and Scripture Union.
- Houses and colours: Galiwango (yellow), Nantume (coffee brown), Kaggwa (blue), and Mukongoni (green).
